### See what's blocking, right on Home
Your running sessions now sit in a card at the bottom of the Home screen: what each one is called, how many apps and sites it covers, how long is left, and a bar showing how far along it is. Click one to open it, edit it, or end it.
The card counts down live and tidies itself away as sessions finish. Fold it down to a small pill with the chevron if you would rather keep Home clear — it stays that way until you open it again.
